paragraphs.text: The Craggy Coast is the rugged southern coastline of southwest Jamuraa , stretching along the shores of the Sea of Serenity on the plane of Dominaria .

Lying just south of the imposing Great Wall , the Craggy Coast is dotted with rocky headlands and overlooks a scatter of unnamed islands in the Sea of Serenity. To the east, its waters merge with the calmer Bay of Pearls .

During Johan's War (3334–3336 AR), the Craggy Coast was significant as a route sailed by Adira Strongheart and her crew in their struggle against the warlord Johan . Its coastal villages and settlements supplied sailors and warriors who were recruited by Hazezon Tamar to stand with Adira and oppose Johan 's ambitions in Jamuraa.
